maria: Heads up — we're planning the leveling cutover next week across APAC + EMEA. Quick Q: do we need manual proration for APAC payroll runs, or can payroll take an automated retro import? cc @tim (payroll)

jon: Short version — APAC runs require a manual CSV upload this quarter because of local payroll provider limits. EMEA can usually accept our automated backpay process if submitted before the 2nd payroll cutoff.

luis (payroll-bot): Payroll bot: APAC payroll cutoff = 2026-03-12 23:59 UTC. Submit files to sftp://payroll-uploads/apac/ by cutoff. Validation will run and you’ll get a report within 1 business day.

anna: If a promotion is effective 2026-03-15, do we set effective_date=2026-03-15 and include retro rows? how do we compute proration days for monthly salaried folks?

jon: Yes — put effective_date=2026-03-15 and include a retro row. Proration = (days_remaining_in_pay_period / days_in_pay_period) * delta_salary. Example: if month has 31 days and promo starts on the 15th, days_remaining = 17 (15th inclusive).

jon: Sample CSV header & row (paste into payroll CSV):

```
employee_id,first_name,last_name,old_annual,new_annual,effective_date,prorated_amount,notes
12345,Sam,Lee,90000,100000,2026-03-15, (100000-90000) * (17/31),"mid-month level change, manager: @anna"
```

jon: We validate formulas server-side; please submit numeric prorated_amount as final value. If you need payroll to calculate, add notes `calculate_proration:true` but expect an extra review.

tim (payroll): @maria @anna — if you add `calculate_proration:true` we'll queue it, but that pushes processing to manual review and may miss the APAC cutoff. Recommend managers calculate when possible.

anna: ok will calculate and upload. one more Q — do equity vesting bands change impact payroll?

jon: Equity doesn't go through payroll for gross salary; notify CompOps and StockOps for equity band changes. Only include cash comp changes in the CSV.

maria: Thanks — i'll coordinate with managers to get CSVs in the SFTP by the cutoff and cc payroll for validation. :thumbsup:

luis (payroll-bot): Payroll bot: validation report will be posted to #payroll-ops channel once file ingested.

maria: Great — closing the loop here. If anyone hits an edge case ping me or @jon. :rocket:
